description: Business key đợt chào bán — component 1 của Composite BK
etl_logic: pc_securities_offering.pc_securities_offering_code

description: Business key hình thức chào bán — component 2 của Composite BK
etl_logic: LEFT JOIN pc_securities_offering_plan ON pc_securities_offering_plan.pc_securities_offering_id = pc_securities_offering.pc_securities_offering_id AND pc_securities_offering_plan.src_stm_code = 'IDS_SECURITIES_OFFERING_PLAN' AND pc_securities_offering_plan.deleted_ind = 0 → pc_securities_offering_plan.offering_method_code

description: Tên gốc hình thức chào bán — lấy từ danh mục Classification Value (cl_value) theo mã offering_method_code
etl_logic: LOOKUP cl_value ON cl_value.cl_code = offering_method_code AND cl_value.schema_code = 'SO_OFFERING_METHOD' → cl_value.cl_nm

description: Mã công ty đại chúng
etl_logic: LEFT JOIN public_company ON public_company.pc_code = pc_securities_offering.pc_code AND public_company.src_stm_code = 'IDS_COMPANY_PROFILES' AND public_company.deleted_ind = 0 → public_company.pc_code

description: Tên doanh nghiệp
etl_logic: LEFT JOIN public_company ON public_company.pc_code = pc_securities_offering.pc_code AND public_company.src_stm_code = 'IDS_COMPANY_PROFILES' AND public_company.deleted_ind = 0 → public_company.pc_nm

description: Mã chứng khoán
etl_logic: LEFT JOIN public_company ON public_company.pc_code = pc_securities_offering.pc_code AND public_company.src_stm_code = 'IDS_COMPANY_PROFILES' AND public_company.deleted_ind = 0 → public_company.equity_ticker_symbol

description: Loại chứng khoán
etl_logic: LEFT JOIN public_company ON public_company.pc_code = pc_securities_offering.pc_code AND public_company.src_stm_code = 'IDS_COMPANY_PROFILES' AND public_company.deleted_ind = 0 → public_company.securities_tp_code

description: Ngành
etl_logic: LEFT JOIN public_company ON public_company.pc_code = pc_securities_offering.pc_code AND public_company.src_stm_code = 'IDS_COMPANY_PROFILES' AND public_company.deleted_ind = 0 → public_company.business_line_level_1_code

description: Tên ngành — JOIN cl_business_line ON cl_business_line.cl_business_line_id = public_company.business_line_level_1_id, đệm sẵn tên ngành để tránh join 3 tầng khi hiển thị 360 Profile. Join qua Id (không phải Code) theo khuyến nghị Atomic designer 2026-07-27
etl_logic: JOIN public_company ON public_company.pc_code = pc_securities_offering.pc_code AND public_company.src_stm_code = 'IDS_COMPANY_PROFILES' AND public_company.deleted_ind = 0 LEFT JOIN cl_business_line ON cl_business_line.cl_business_line_id = public_company.business_line_level_1_id → cl_business_line.cl_business_line_nm

description: Sàn
etl_logic: LEFT JOIN public_company ON public_company.pc_code = pc_securities_offering.pc_code AND public_company.src_stm_code = 'IDS_COMPANY_PROFILES' AND public_company.deleted_ind = 0 → public_company.equity_listing_exchange_code

description: Số lượng CK chào bán thành công theo loại hình
etl_logic: LEFT JOIN pc_securities_offering_plan ON pc_securities_offering_plan.pc_securities_offering_id = pc_securities_offering.pc_securities_offering_id AND pc_securities_offering_plan.src_stm_code = 'IDS_SECURITIES_OFFERING_PLAN' AND pc_securities_offering_plan.deleted_ind = 0 LEFT JOIN pc_securities_offering_result ON pc_securities_offering_result.pc_securities_offering_id = pc_securities_offering.pc_securities_offering_id AND pc_securities_offering_result.offering_method_code_snpst = pc_securities_offering_plan.offering_method_code AND pc_securities_offering_result.src_stm_code = 'IDS_SECURITIES_OFFERING_RESULT' AND pc_securities_offering_result.deleted_ind = 0 → SUM(pc_securities_offering_result.total_successful_quantity)

description: Giá trị chào bán thành công theo loại hình
etl_logic: LEFT JOIN pc_securities_offering_plan ON pc_securities_offering_plan.pc_securities_offering_id = pc_securities_offering.pc_securities_offering_id AND pc_securities_offering_plan.src_stm_code = 'IDS_SECURITIES_OFFERING_PLAN' AND pc_securities_offering_plan.deleted_ind = 0 LEFT JOIN pc_securities_offering_result ON pc_securities_offering_result.pc_securities_offering_id = pc_securities_offering.pc_securities_offering_id AND pc_securities_offering_result.offering_method_code_snpst = pc_securities_offering_plan.offering_method_code AND pc_securities_offering_result.src_stm_code = 'IDS_SECURITIES_OFFERING_RESULT' AND pc_securities_offering_result.deleted_ind = 0 → SUM(pc_securities_offering_result.total_collected_amt)

description: Tỷ lệ chào bán thành công theo loại hình — tính lại từ số lượng cấp phép/thành công đã gộp theo đợt báo cáo (khớp cách BA tự tính ở Nhóm 4 bảng chi tiết)
etl_logic: LEFT JOIN pc_securities_offering_plan ON pc_securities_offering_plan.pc_securities_offering_id = pc_securities_offering.pc_securities_offering_id AND pc_securities_offering_plan.src_stm_code = 'IDS_SECURITIES_OFFERING_PLAN' AND pc_securities_offering_plan.deleted_ind = 0 LEFT JOIN pc_securities_offering_result ON pc_securities_offering_result.pc_securities_offering_id = pc_securities_offering.pc_securities_offering_id AND pc_securities_offering_result.offering_method_code_snpst = pc_securities_offering_plan.offering_method_code AND pc_securities_offering_result.src_stm_code = 'IDS_SECURITIES_OFFERING_RESULT' AND pc_securities_offering_result.deleted_ind = 0 → ROUND(SUM(pc_securities_offering_result.total_successful_quantity) / NULLIF(pc_securities_offering.total_registered_quantity, 0) * 100, 2)

description: Giá cấp phép bình quân toàn hồ sơ (không phân biệt loại hình)
etl_logic: LEFT JOIN pc_securities_offering_plan ON pc_securities_offering_plan.pc_securities_offering_id = pc_securities_offering.pc_securities_offering_id AND pc_securities_offering_plan.src_stm_code = 'IDS_SECURITIES_OFFERING_PLAN' AND pc_securities_offering_plan.deleted_ind = 0 → AVG(pc_securities_offering_plan.offering_price)

description: Số lượng người lao động kế hoạch — tổng toàn hồ sơ (không phân biệt loại hình)
etl_logic: LEFT JOIN pc_securities_offering_plan ON pc_securities_offering_plan.pc_securities_offering_id = pc_securities_offering.pc_securities_offering_id AND pc_securities_offering_plan.src_stm_code = 'IDS_SECURITIES_OFFERING_PLAN' AND pc_securities_offering_plan.deleted_ind = 0 → SUM(pc_securities_offering_plan.employee_quantity)

description: Đối tượng chào bán — chỉ có giá trị khi phát hành riêng lẻ theo hình thức đại diện (MIN offering_method_code gộp theo hồ sơ = '5'); các hình thức khác NULL
etl_logic: LEFT JOIN pc_securities_offering_plan ON pc_securities_offering_plan.pc_securities_offering_id = pc_securities_offering.pc_securities_offering_id AND pc_securities_offering_plan.src_stm_code = 'IDS_SECURITIES_OFFERING_PLAN' AND pc_securities_offering_plan.deleted_ind = 0 LEFT JOIN public_company ON public_company.pc_code = pc_securities_offering.pc_code AND public_company.src_stm_code = 'IDS_COMPANY_PROFILES' AND public_company.deleted_ind = 0 → CASE WHEN MIN(pc_securities_offering_plan.offering_method_code) = '5' THEN public_company.pc_nm ELSE NULL END
source_entity: Public Company Securities Offering Plan / Public Company
source_attribute: Offering Method Code / Public Company Name

description: Giá thực tế theo loại hình — bình quân qua các đợt báo cáo kết quả
etl_logic: LEFT JOIN pc_securities_offering_plan ON pc_securities_offering_plan.pc_securities_offering_id = pc_securities_offering.pc_securities_offering_id AND pc_securities_offering_plan.src_stm_code = 'IDS_SECURITIES_OFFERING_PLAN' AND pc_securities_offering_plan.deleted_ind = 0 LEFT JOIN pc_securities_offering_result ON pc_securities_offering_result.pc_securities_offering_id = pc_securities_offering.pc_securities_offering_id AND pc_securities_offering_result.offering_method_code_snpst = pc_securities_offering_plan.offering_method_code AND pc_securities_offering_result.src_stm_code = 'IDS_SECURITIES_OFFERING_RESULT' AND pc_securities_offering_result.deleted_ind = 0 → AVG(pc_securities_offering_result.actual_offering_price)

description: Số lượng người lao động thực tế theo loại hình
etl_logic: LEFT JOIN pc_securities_offering_plan ON pc_securities_offering_plan.pc_securities_offering_id = pc_securities_offering.pc_securities_offering_id AND pc_securities_offering_plan.src_stm_code = 'IDS_SECURITIES_OFFERING_PLAN' AND pc_securities_offering_plan.deleted_ind = 0 LEFT JOIN pc_securities_offering_result ON pc_securities_offering_result.pc_securities_offering_id = pc_securities_offering.pc_securities_offering_id AND pc_securities_offering_result.offering_method_code_snpst = pc_securities_offering_plan.offering_method_code AND pc_securities_offering_result.src_stm_code = 'IDS_SECURITIES_OFFERING_RESULT' AND pc_securities_offering_result.deleted_ind = 0 → SUM(pc_securities_offering_result.employee_quantity)

description: Đối tượng chào bán (thực tế) — chỉ có giá trị khi phát hành riêng lẻ theo offering_method_code_snpst ghi trên Result (không phải Plan); các hình thức khác NULL
etl_logic: LEFT JOIN pc_securities_offering_result ON pc_securities_offering_result.pc_securities_offering_id = pc_securities_offering.pc_securities_offering_id AND pc_securities_offering_result.offering_method_code_snpst = pc_securities_offering_plan.offering_method_code AND pc_securities_offering_result.src_stm_code = 'IDS_SECURITIES_OFFERING_RESULT' AND pc_securities_offering_result.deleted_ind = 0 → CASE WHEN pc_securities_offering_result.offering_method_code_snpst = '5' THEN public_company.public_company_nm ELSE NULL END — LEFT JOIN public_company ON public_company.pc_code = pc_securities_offering.pc_code AND public_company.src_stm_code = 'IDS_COMPANY_PROFILES' AND public_company.deleted_ind = 0 → public_company.pc_nm

description: Mã hệ thống nguồn — hardcode IDS.SECURITIES_OFFERING. Driving filter: WHERE pc_securities_offering.deleted_ind = 0 (loại bản ghi đã xóa mềm) áp dụng cho toàn bộ Operational
etl_logic: pc_securities_offering.src_stm_code WHERE pc_securities_offering.src_stm_code = 'IDS_SECURITIES_OFFERING' AND pc_securities_offering.deleted_ind = 0
